data.label: include
data.reason_zh: Cortex 将开发者会话中的修正转为可回放任务，用重复运行反馈筛选技能或规则，并把有效改动保留到 held-out 任务，属 Harness 持续改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: finds the corrections that recur, writes one skill or rule at a time, and keeps it only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task made noticeably worse.
scope_support.object_quote: We present Cortex, a tool that tests changes to the harness instead of trusting them.
scope_support.persistence_quote: On held-out tasks, the harnesses it built made the agent follow the conventions far more often than no skills or rules did
